name: Commercial-grade Tactile Array Sensor
summary: A flexible pressure-array sensor family for industrial robot touch sensing and commercial pressure-monitoring equipment. Sycsense offers standard and custom arrays with multiple interface options, although the product page does not identify the individual protocols or model codes. The specified detection range is 0–2000 kPa.
